claim: Một master binding có thể nhận nhiều shadow qua mảng transform_spec.shadow_sources.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/centralized-data-service/internal/repository/master/master_binding_repo.go:109-119
		   JOIN cdc_system.shadow_binding sb ON (
		     sb.id = mb.shadow_binding_id
		     OR EXISTS (
		       SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
		         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources') = 'array' THEN mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
		       ) elem
		        WHERE (CASE WHEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id')::bigint END) = sb.id
		           OR (elem->>'shadow_table' = sb.shadow_table
		               AND COALESCE(NULLIF(elem->>'shadow_schema', ''), sb.shadow_schema) = sb.shadow_schema)
		     )
		   )
